title: The Last Parachute
desc: From the high moor a narrow iron ledge is the only foothold above a long, killing drop, and there are just two parachutes in the shepherd's pack. Whoever floats down first must make the way safe for everyone else.
hint: A staircase built from the valley toward the cliff can catch sheep falling from the ledge. Keep the flock on the ledge until it is ready.
